findings.location: Paragraph: "Mr. Bridges’ hymns are marked..." (translation paragraph beginning 'Vi fortsätter med vår berättelse. Matthew Bridges konverterade...')
findings.source_quote: Mr. Bridges’ hymns are marked by spirituality and genuine power.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate or localize the English honorific and possessive. Replace the phrase in-place preserving tags, e.g.: "Bridges psalmer kännetecknas av andlighet och äkta kraft."
findings.translation_quote: Mr Bridges’ psalmer kännetecknas av andlighet och äkta kraft.

findings.location: Lyrics (Bridges section) — multiple lines where "Honom" and other pronouns are capitalized (e.g., "Krona Honom med många kronor, Lammet på sin tron;")
findings.source_quote: Crown Him with many crowns, the Lamb upon His throne;
findings.suggested_fix: Swedish convention does not capitalize pronouns for God except in some devotional styles. For a standard contemporary Swedish rendering, lowercase pronouns is preferred. Example replacement: "Kröna honom med många kronor, lammet på sin tron;" (apply consistently to other occurrences of Honom/Du/Ty etc.). Preserve HTML and stanza structure.
findings.translation_quote: Krona Honom med många kronor, Lammet på sin tron;

findings.location: Paragraph: "Crown Him the Lord of heaven! One with the Father known,..." (translation paragraph about 'triune throne')
findings.source_quote: Crown Him the Lord of heaven! One with the Father known, And the blest Spirit, through Him given from yonder triune throne!
findings.suggested_fix: "Triune" is an English theological adjective; render it into idiomatic Swedish. Replace with "treeniga" or a clearer phrase such as "treeniga tronen" or "den treeniga tronen". Example: "…och den saliga Anden, genom honom given från den treeniga tronen där borta!" Preserve punctuation and tags.
findings.translation_quote: ...Och den saliga Anden, genom Honom given från den triune tronen där borta!
